## Get the genes that are significant in any given comparison

```{r data}
res = read.table('DCK_results/EG_sig_padj_DCK.tsv', header=T, sep="\t", row.names = 1)

all_res <- read.delim("DCK_results/EG_all_results_table_DCK_noMT.tsv")   # first col is a row index

length(unique(all_res$gene_id))                              # everything
length(unique(all_res$gene_id[!is.na(all_res$pvalue)]))      # got a test
universe <- unique(all_res$gene_id[!is.na(all_res$padj)])    # eligible
length(universe)

sig <- unique(all_res$gene_id[!is.na(all_res$padj) & all_res$padj < 0.1])
length(sig)
```

```{r GO terms found by emapper}
lines <- readLines("emapper-out/ctar.emapper.annotations")
hdr   <- grep("^#query", lines)
emap  <- read_tsv("emapper-out/ctar.emapper.annotations", skip = hdr - 1)
names(emap)[1] <- "query"

gene2go <- emap %>%
  filter(GOs != "-") %>%
  select(query, GOs) %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",")

geneID2GO <- split(gene2go$GOs, gene2go$query)   # topGO
```


```{r check the number annotated, echo=FALSE}
gonames = names(table(gene2go$query))
mean(universe %in% gonames)
mean(sig %in% gonames)  
# .62 < .74 implies significant genes are the ones that tend to be annotated, rather than uniform annotation
```

```{r annotated genes have a higher overall expression level}
bm <- aggregate(baseMean ~ gene_id, data = all_res, FUN = mean)
bm <- bm[bm$gene_id %in% universe, ]
bm$annot <- bm$gene_id %in% gonames
tapply(bm$baseMean, bm$annot, median)
wilcox.test(baseMean ~ annot, data = bm)
```

```{r breakdown of coverage gap by expression}
bm$sig <- bm$gene_id %in% sig
bm$bin <- cut(bm$baseMean, quantile(bm$baseMean, seq(0, 1, 0.2)),
              include.lowest = TRUE)

t(sapply(split(bm, bm$bin), function(d)
  c(n = nrow(d),
    univ_annot = mean(d$annot),
    sig_annot  = mean(d$annot[d$sig]),
    n_sig      = sum(d$sig))))
```
```{r basic topGO run}
allGenes <- factor(as.integer(universe %in% sig))
names(allGenes) <- universe
GOdata <- new("topGOdata",
  ontology = "BP", allGenes = allGenes,
  annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = geneID2GO, nodeSize = 10)

fisher_w01 <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher")
```

```{r do all ontos}
run_onto <- function(onto, allGenes) {
  gd <- new("topGOdata", ontology = onto, allGenes = allGenes,
            annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = geneID2GO, nodeSize = 10)

  # DAG pruning avoids exhaustive testing but can't be subject to p.adjust
  ft  <- runTest(gd, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher")
  # exhaustive tests are more numerous, but independent, so p-values can be adjusted
  ftc <- runTest(gd, algorithm = "classic",  statistic = "fisher")

  w  <- score(ft)                      # named numeric, all scored terms
  cs <- score(ftc)
  fdr <- p.adjust(cs, "BH")            # across everything, not top 50

  tb <- GenTable(gd, weight01 = ft, classic = ftc,
                 orderBy = "weight01", topNodes = 50, numChar = 200)

  tb$weight01_p  <- w[tb$GO.ID]        # numeric, no string parsing
  tb$classic_p   <- cs[tb$GO.ID]
  tb$classic_fdr <- fdr[tb$GO.ID]
  tb$fold        <- tb$Significant / tb$Expected
  tb$ontology    <- onto

  sg  <- sigGenes(gd)
  git <- genesInTerm(gd, tb$GO.ID)
  tb$sig_genes <- sapply(git, function(g)
                    paste(sort(intersect(g, sg)), collapse = ";"))

  list(test = ft, test_classic = ftc, table = tb, n_scored = length(cs))
}

runs <- lapply(c("BP", "MF", "CC"), function(onto) {run_onto(onto, allGenes)})
names(runs) <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")
all_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(runs, `[[`, "table"))
```

```{r make gene lists}
add_genes <- function(r) {
  sg <- sigGenes(r$godata)
  gt <- genesInTerm(r$godata, r$table$GO.ID)
  r$table$sig_genes <- sapply(gt, function(g)
    paste(sort(intersect(g, sg)), collapse = ";"))
  r$table
}
all_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(runs, add_genes))
```

```{r prepare sets to do enrichment by condition}
by_comp <- split(all_res, all_res$comparison)

sets <- lapply(by_comp, function(d) {
  u <- d$gene_id[!is.na(d$padj)]
  list(universe = u,
       sig      = d$gene_id[!is.na(d$padj) & d$padj < 0.1])
})

data.frame(
  comparison = names(sets),
  universe   = sapply(sets, function(s) length(s$universe)),
  sig        = sapply(sets, function(s) length(s$sig)),
  sig_annot  = sapply(sets, function(s) sum(s$sig %in% gonames))
)
```


```{r run GO-term enrichment for comparables} 

comparables = c("T22_mock vs T22_WNV",  "T26_mock vs T26_WNV",  "T30_mock vs T30_WNV",  # mock vs WNV at each temp
                "T22_mock vs T26_mock", "T22_mock vs T30_mock", "T26_mock vs T30_mock", # temp effect in mock
                "T22_WNV vs T26_WNV",   "T22_WNV vs T30_WNV",   "T26_WNV vs T30_WNV")   # temp effect in WNV

MIN_SIG_ANNOT <- 20

results_list = lapply(comparables, function(x) {
  genesets = sets[[x]]
  sig = genesets$sig
  universe = genesets$universe
  
  n_annot <- sum(sig %in% gonames)
  if (n_annot < MIN_SIG_ANNOT)
  {
    message(sprintf("%-24s skipped: %d annotated sig genes", x, n_annot))
    # df row for failed due to not enough significant/annotated
    # return metadata only
    return(data.frame(comparison = x, n_sig = length(sig),
                  n_sig_annot = n_annot, n_universe = length(universe),
                  n_universe_annot = sum(universe %in% gonames),
                  n_terms_scored = NA_integer_, status = "too_few",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  
  # remake a vector 0/1 of gene in significant category
  allGenes <- factor(as.integer(universe %in% sig))
  names(allGenes) <- universe
  runs <- lapply(c("BP", "MF", "CC"), function(onto) {run_onto(onto, allGenes)})
  names(runs) <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")
  tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(runs, `[[`, "table"))
  data.frame(comparison = x, n_sig = length(sig), n_sig_annot = n_annot,
             n_universe = length(universe), status = "ok",
             tab, row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

combined <- bind_rows(results_list)

```

```{r combined summaries}
combined$block <- ifelse(
  grepl("mock vs T\\d+_WNV", combined$comparison), "infection effect",
  ifelse(grepl("mock vs .*mock", combined$comparison),
         "temperature effect (mock)", "temperature effect (WNV)"))

combined$fold <- combined$Significant / combined$Expected

combined <- combined[order(combined$block, combined$comparison,
                           combined$ontology, combined$p_num), ]

write.table(combined, "GO_enrichment_by_comparison.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
